sanskrit_verse:
पश्वाज्यर्त्विगादीनां संयोगाज् जायतेऽध्वरः ।
यथा संबध्यते तेन व्यवहारस् तथोच्यते ॥
transliteration: paśvājyartvigādīnāṃ saṃyogāj jāyate 'dhvaraḥ / yathā saṃbadhyate tena vyavahāras tathocyate //
sph_interpretive_translation: From the conjunction of sacrificial animals, clarified butter, and officiating priests arises the ritual action; likewise, human conduct emerges from the conjunction of beings and is therefore designated accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in relational conjunction, not individual will
Causation follows sequential conjunction, not isolated intent
Capacity-based responsibility arises through participation in collective dharma
Restoration logic aligns action with its causal field
Consciousness alignment depends on recognition of interdependent origination
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A participates in systemic conjunction C THEN A assumes role-defined capacity R within C
IF action X arises from collective participation THEN attribution is distributed across all contributory agents
IF conduct Y is defined by relational context Z THEN legal identity of Y is derived from Z
IF violation occurs THEN restoration targets the disrupted relational field, not the individual alone
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that legal identities and responsibilities arise relationally. The threshold of responsibility is determined by degree of conjunction with the operative system, not by isolated intent or act. Authority flows from alignment with cosmic order, not hierarchical position.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that action arises through conjunction, not autonomous choice. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that conduct is sequentially conditioned by relational fields. Responsibility is proportional to the extent of conjunction, not moral fault. Non-punitive reality recognizes that misalignment disrupts the field and requires realignment, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establish correct conjunction through dharmic alignment practices
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge relational participation and restore integrity to the field
Capacity Restoration: Realign individual consciousness with collective dharma through guided sādhanā
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate return to harmonious conjunction through community-based restitution
final_declaration: Thus declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Action arises from conjunction, not separation. Justice restores relational harmony. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator. All else is derivative.
